steps.title: Configure App Meta Data
steps.description: Establish the exact application name 'Focus Timer' and map it to the package identifier 'com.focustimer.app' inside app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Environment
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with target and compile SDK 34, min SDK 21, Java 8 compatibility, using Gradle 8.5 and Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2. Ensure zero third-party dependencies are added to keep compilation clean and purely native.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest & Permissions
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml referencing the correct namespace, custom package, and standard lightweight material light theme with no action bar, avoiding AndroidX dependencies.

steps.title: Design Circular Progress Canvas View
steps.description: Develop a high-performance custom CircularProgressView canvas class using native standard 2D graphics Paint and Arc calculations. This custom view renders the running focus status programmatically with zero dependencies.

steps.title: Create Premium Design Style Selectors
steps.description: Develop card XML shapes, accent and secondary flat button states, and preset rounded capsule selection drawables with precise focused/unfocused primary colors.

steps.title: Create Dynamic Text Selectors
steps.description: Build high-contrast XML color state lists so texts dynamically adapt to selected states inside active presets and custom tabs.

steps.title: Create Main Activity UI Structure
steps.description: Develop the primary layout activity_main.xml featuring three distinct modular screens (Timer, History, Settings) toggled cleanly by a modern bottom tab bar navigation panel.

steps.title: Create Focus Completion Overlay Layout
steps.description: Design an elegant custom dialog layout dialog_complete.xml that renders on completion of focus periods with positive reinforcement and custom illustrations.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Controller
steps.description: Program the complete functional backend in MainActivity.java. Establish robust, leak-proof countdown handles, active/paused layout state-switches, and state preservation upon configuration rotation.

steps.title: Implement Local History Logging System
steps.description: Integrate robust SharedPreferences serialization logic to store, parse, and filter completed focus entries by timestamp. Show clear performance metrics, daily totals, and logs dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Native Beep Sound fallback
steps.description: Verify RingtoneManager notification resources and implement standard native ToneGenerator beep system fallbacks inside focus termination triggers.

steps.title: Building Focus Timer
steps.description: Initiate absolute validation of native compilation paths, manifest properties and layout alignments to assemble the final APK successfully.
